sections.title: Not everything needs the cloud
body: Embeddings, classification and anything touching private data can often run on the device: cheaper, private and available offline.

sections.title: Same traits, different engine
body: Gateway’s local providers run llama.cpp, ONNX Runtime and FastEmbed in-process, implementing the same capability traits as the cloud adapters, so code doesn’t care where a model runs. Each engine is an opt-in feature.

sections.title: The Gateway idea
body: One interface, fallback chains, circuit breakers, budgets, and local models alongside cloud ones. That is the first four weeks; the series continues.
